kebab_example: aliyun rtc start-agent --app-id aoe0000 --channel-id yourChannelId --task-id yourTaskId --template-id 76dasgb0000 --rtc-config 2 --voice-chat-config '{"AmbientSoundConfig":{"Volume":50,"SoundId":"white_noise"},"Greeting":"早上好，我的朋友","LLMConfig":{"Temperature":0.7,"ApiKey":"xxxxxxxxxxx","MaxToken":500,"Tools":["example-string"],"Params":"verification_code_:_xxx","ToolExecutionConfig":"example-string","Vendor":"aliyun","Url":"https://xxxxx","BizParams":"example-string","AppId":"e0000","Model":"qwen-plus","HistoryDepth":3,"Prompt":"xxxx","TopP":0.8},"BackChannelConfig":{"Version":1,"UserTurnEnd":false},"TTSConfig":{"ApiKey":"xxxxxx","FilterBrackets":[1],"Volume":50,"Rate":1.0,"Model":"cosyvoice-v1","Pitch":1.0,"Vendor":"aliyun","Voice":"longxiaoxia"},"InterruptConfig":{"SemanticsInterrupt":true},"ASRConfig":{"SourceLanguage":"zh","VocabularyId":"vocab-xxx-24ee19fa8cfb4d52902170a0xxxxxxxx","MaxSentenceSilence":800,"LanguageHints":["zh"],"SemanticPunctuationEnabled":false,"VadConfig":{"InterruptSpeechDuration":300}},"AgentSilenceConfig":{"Content":"00","WebhookTriggerTimeout":0,"Enable":false,"Strategy":1,"AlertTimeout":0},"EnableVideoUnderstanding":true,"InterruptMode":1,"preferVideo":1,"ChatMode":1}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartAgent

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query this ID in the console. Only one application ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to join. Only one channel ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 加入的频道，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

fields.help_en: A list of user IDs that the agent subscribes to. Currently, only a single user ID is supported
fields.help_zh: 智能体订阅的用户userId列表，目前仅支持一个
fields.name: target_user_ids

fields.help_en: The user ID for the agent in the RTC channel
fields.help_zh: 智能体在rtc频道中的userId
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en:
The maximum duration of user inactivity, in seconds. The agent automatically stops and leaves the channel if either of the following conditions is met for this duration: All users in the `targetUserIds` list have left the channel. No users from the `targetUserIds` list have joined the channel. Default: 30.
Range: [5, 180].
fields.help_zh:
定义用户无活动状态的最大持续时间阈值（单位：秒）
当检测到以下任一状态持续时间达到该阈值时，智能体将自动停止并退出频道：
targetUserIds列表中的所有用户已全部离开频道
targetUserIds列表未加入频道

默认值：30
取值范围：[5, 180]
fields.name: user_inactivity_timeout

parameters.help_en: The configuration for the agent to join an RTC channel
parameters.help_zh: 智能体加入rtc频道的配置
parameters.name: rtc_config

fields.help_en:
If this parameter is not set, the model automatically detects the language.
Supported language codes:
• `zh`: Chinese (supports dialects including Shanghainese, Wu, Minnan, Northeastern Mandarin, Gansu, Guizhou, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Ningxia, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Shandong, Sichuan, Tianjin, Yunnan, and Cantonese)
• `en`: English
• `ja`: Japanese
• `yue`: Cantonese
• `ko`: Korean
fields.help_zh:
不设置，模型会自动识别语种。
目前支持的语言代码：
zh: 中文（支持方言：上海话、吴语、闽南语、东北话、甘肃话、贵州话、河南话、湖北话、湖南话、江西话、宁夏话、山西话、陕西话、山东话、四川话、天津话、云南话、粤语）
en: 英文
ja: 日语
yue: 粤语
ko: 韩语
fields.name: language_hints

fields.help_en:
The silence duration threshold, in milliseconds, for VAD-based sentence segmentation.
Default: 800.
Recommended range: [200, 6000].
fields.help_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，默认800ms，参考范围[200,6000]
fields.name: max_sentence_silence

fields.help_en: Enables semantic punctuation for sentence segmentation. If `false`, segmentation is based on Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
fields.help_zh: 语义断句/语音断句
fields.name: semantic_punctuation_enabled

fields.help_en: The language is automatically detected, so this parameter is not required
fields.help_zh: 无需设置
fields.name: source_language

fields.help_en:
The minimum duration, in milliseconds (ms), of continuous human speech required to trigger an interruption. This helps prevent false interruptions.
Default: 300.
Range: [0, 3000].
fields.help_zh:
人声持续阈值 (ms)，取值范围为[0,3000]。持续检测到人声信号的最小时间长度，避免误打断。
默认300ms
fields.name: interrupt_speech_duration

fields.help_en: Configuration for Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
fields.help_zh: vad配置
fields.name: vad_config

fields.help_en: The ID of the custom vocabulary to use
fields.help_zh: 支持的热词ID
fields.name: vocabulary_id

fields.help_en: Configuration for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
fields.help_zh: ASR配置
fields.name: asr_config

fields.help_en:
The timeout in seconds before triggering a silence alert. The alert can be re-triggered if the silence continues.
Range: [5, 600].
Default: 0 (disabled).
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的超时时间（单位：秒）。
可能多次触发，若智能体静默提醒超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发
取值范围：[5, 600]，默认值0，0表示不提醒
fields.name: alert_timeout

fields.help_en: The content of the silence alert message
fields.help_zh: 静默提示消息的内容
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the silence configuration
fields.help_zh: 开关
fields.name: enable

fields.help_en:
The strategy for the silence alert:
• `1` (default): Plays the message specified in `Content`.
• `2`: Sends the `Content` message and conversation history to the LLM, and then plays the generated response.
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的话术策略。
1 - 向用户语音播报content指定的提示消息
2 - 把content指定的提示消息和历史对话发送给LLM，并播报模型生成的回复
默认值：1
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en:
The timeout in seconds before triggering a silence webhook. The webhook can be re-triggered if the silence continues.
Range: [10, 600].
Default: 0 (disabled).
fields.help_zh:
触发智能体静默超时webhook的静默超时时间（单位：秒）。可能多次触发，若智能体webhook静默超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发
取值范围：[10, 600]，默认值0，0表示不触发
fields.name: webhook_trigger_timeout

fields.help_en: Configures how the agent responds to silence, such as when a user is in the channel but not speaking. You can configure the agent to play an audio prompt or send a webhook notification
fields.help_zh: 当用户加入频道后，但未与智能体进行有效交互（用户未发言），此时智能体处于静默状态，可以配置智能体在静默状态下的行为：播报静默语音消息提醒或webhook通知
fields.name: agent_silence_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies the ambient sound to play.

If this parameter is not provided, ambient sound is disabled.

Built-in sounds: Set to `white_noise` or `office`.

For custom sounds, provide a `soundId` that you have configured in the console with a corresponding download URL. (This feature is planned for a future release)
fields.help_zh:
环境音计划支持内置与下载（后续），当前先实现内置模式
当不传字段或者字段为空时，表示不开启环境音
内置模式：agent提供以下默认环境音：white_noise（白噪声）office（办公室）
下载模式：支持客户在控制台填写soundId（不可与内置id相同），并填写url，agent内部会进行下载并绑定
fields.name: sound_id

fields.help_en:
The volume of the ambient sound.
Range: [0, 100].
Default: 50.
fields.help_zh: 环境音音量，默认50（原声）。范围【0 - 100】
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: Configuration for ambient sound
fields.help_zh: 环境音设置
fields.name: ambient_sound_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable back-channeling after the user finishes speaking.
Default: `false`.
fields.help_zh: 用户说完话后，是否开启承接词。默认值是false
fields.name: user_turn_end

fields.help_en: The Version
fields.help_zh: The Version
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: Configuration for back-channeling
fields.help_zh: 承接词设置
fields.name: back_channel_config

fields.help_en:
`1`: Natural conversation mode (default).
`2`: Walkie-talkie mode.
fields.help_zh: 1-自然对话模式 (默认值); 2-对讲机模式
fields.name: chat_mode

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable video understanding. If enabled, the LLM must support multimodal inputs
fields.help_zh: 是否开启视觉理解如果开启，LLM模型必须支持多模态数据
fields.name: enable_video_understanding

fields.help_en: The agent's initial greeting
fields.help_zh: 问候语
fields.name: greeting

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable semantic interruption.
Default: `true`.
fields.help_zh: 是否开启语义打断。默认值是true
fields.name: semantics_interrupt

fields.help_en: Configuration for interruption handling
fields.help_zh: 打断设置
fields.name: interrupt_config

fields.help_en:
`1`: Enables voice interruption (default).
`2`: Disables voice interruption.
fields.help_zh: 1-支持语音打断 (默认值)，2-禁用语音打断
fields.name: interrupt_mode

fields.help_en: The API key from the cloud service provider
fields.help_zh: 服务商apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: The agent application ID. You can specify either `Model` or `AppId`. If both are provided, `AppId` takes precedence
fields.help_zh:
智能体应用ID
model，appId二选一即可。如果model，appId都填写了，优先使用appId
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: Custom parameters
fields.help_zh: 自定义参数
fields.name: biz_params

fields.help_en:
The number of previous conversation turns to include as context for the model.
Default: 3.
fields.help_zh:
给大模型提供多少历史对话轮次。
默认值3
fields.name: history_depth

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of tokens for the generated response. For `deepseek` and `qwen` models, the upper limit is 8192.
Default: 8192.
fields.help_zh:
输出文本的最大限制，默认值8192
deepseek qwen模型最大值为8192
fields.name: max_token

fields.help_en:
The name of the model.
For the `aliyun` vendor, supported models include `qwen-plus`, `deepseek-r1`, and `qwen-omni-turbo`.
fields.help_zh:
模型名称
aliyun服务商下支持模型:
["qwen-plus", "deepseek-r1", "qwen-omni-turbo"]
fields.name: model

fields.help_en: A key-value map for custom parameters. This parameter is deprecated; use `BizParams` instead
fields.help_zh: 用户自定义参数，键值对。即将弃用，请使用bizParams字段
fields.name: params

fields.help_en: A system prompt that instructs the model on its role, behavior, or persona
fields.help_zh: 用于告知模型要扮演的角色或行为
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en:
The sampling temperature, which controls the randomness of the generated text. A higher value increases randomness.
Range: [0, 2).
Default: 0.7.
Note: This parameter is not supported for the `deepseek-r1` model.
fields.help_zh:
采样温度，用于控制生成文本的随机性和创造性，值越大随机性越高。
默认值0.7
取值范围[0,2)
deepseek-r1设置该参数不生效
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: The ToolExecutionConfig
fields.help_zh: The ToolExecutionConfig
fields.name: tool_execution_config

fields.help_en: The Tools
fields.help_zh: The Tools
fields.name: tools

fields.help_en:
Controls output diversity via nucleus sampling. The model samples from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability mass exceeds this value. A higher value results in a more diverse output.
Range: (0, 1].
Default: 0.8.
fields.help_zh:
采样的选择范围，控制输出 token 的多样性。模型将从概率分布中累计概率超过该取值的标记中进行采样，以确保采样的选择范围不会过宽，值越大输出的 token 类型越丰富。
取值范围(0,1]，默认值0.8
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: The access URL for a third-party LLM
fields.help_zh: 接入第三方的大模型时，此字段表示大模型的接入url
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The name of the cloud service provider. Examples: `aliyun` (for Model Studio), `thirdparty`
fields.help_zh: 接入云服务提供商时，此字段表示服务商的名称。示例：aliyun[百炼]、thirdparty
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en: Configuration for the Large Language Model (LLM)
fields.help_zh: LLM配置
fields.name: llm_config

fields.help_en: The API key from the cloud service provider
fields.help_zh: 服务商apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: Specifies bracket types whose enclosed content should be excluded from speech synthesis
fields.help_zh: 过滤设定符号范围内的字符不被转成语音
fields.name: filter_brackets

fields.help_en: The name of the TTS model. Example: `cosyvoice-v1`
fields.help_zh: 模型名称【cosyvoice-v1】
fields.name: model

fields.help_en:
The pitch of the synthesized speech.
Range: [0.5, 2.0].
Default: 1.0.
fields.name: pitch

fields.help_en:
The speech rate.
Range: [0.5, 2.0].
Default: 1.0.
fields.name: rate

fields.help_en: The cloud service provider. Example: `aliyun` (for Model Studio)
fields.help_zh: 服务提供商 【aliyun【百炼】】
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en:
The voice for the synthesized speech. If you use the `cosyvoice-v1` model from Alibaba Cloud, the default voice is `longxiaoxia`.
Available voices: `longwan`, `longcheng`, `longhua`, `longxiaochun`, `longxiaoxia`, `longxiaocheng`, `longxiaobai`, `longlaotie`, `longshu`, `longshuo`, `longjing`, `longmiao`, `longyue`, `longyuan`, `longfei`, `longjielidou`, `longtong`, `longxiang`, `loongstella`, `loongbella`.
fields.help_zh:
音色。如果选择阿里云cosyvoice-v1，默认音色是longxiaoxia
可选音色：
longwan、longcheng、longhua、longxiaochun、longxiaoxia、longxiaocheng、longxiaobai、longlaotie、longshu、longshuo、longjing、longmiao、longyue、longyuan、longfei、longjielidou、longtong、longxiang、loongstella、loongbella
fields.name: voice

fields.help_en:
The volume of the synthesized speech.
Range: [0, 100].
Default: 50.
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: Configuration for Text-to-Speech (TTS)
fields.help_zh: TTS配置
fields.name: tts_config

fields.help_en:
When video understanding is enabled, specifies which video stream to prioritize if both camera and screen sharing streams are active. The agent can process only one stream at a time.

`1`: Prioritize the camera stream.

`2`: Prioritize the screen sharing stream.

Default: `1`
fields.help_zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流。

智能体优先理解Camera流；
智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流
fields.name: prefer_video

parameters.help_en: The configuration for AI voice chat
parameters.name: voice_chat_config

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
